task: Show me the comparison of the first two personal credit cards that do not charge foreign transaction fees.
agent_final_answer:
Navigating from the American Express homepage to the Personal Credit Cards directory and filtering for cards with **No Foreign Transaction Fee**, the first two personal cards listed are:

1. **The Platinum Card® from American Express**
2. **American Express® Gold Card**

Below is the side-by-side comparison from the American Express Card Comparison tool:

---

### Card Overview

| Feature | The Platinum Card® from American Express | American Express® Gold Card |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Annual Fee** | $895 | $325 |
| **Foreign Transaction Fees** | None (No foreign transaction fees) | None (No foreign transaction fees) |
| **Welcome Offer** | As high as 175,000 Membership Rewards® points after spending $12,000 in purchases within the first 6 months | As high as 100,000 Membership Rewards® points after spending $8,000 in purchases within the first 6 months |
| **APR (Pay Over Time)** | 19.74% to 28.74% variable APR on eligible charges | 19.74% to 28.74% variable APR on eligible charges |
| **Rewards Program** | Membership Rewards® Points | Membership Rewards® Points |

---

### How You Earn Points

| Category | The Platinum Card® | American Express® Gold Card |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dining / Restaurants** | 1X points on purchases | 4X points at restaurants worldwide (on up to $50,000 per calendar year, then 1X) |
| **Supermarkets** | 1X points on purchases | 4X points at U.S. supermarkets (on up to $25,000 per calendar year, then 1X) |
| **Flights** | 5X points on flights booked directly with airlines or through American Express Travel® (up to $500,000/yr) | 3X points on flights booked directly with airlines or on AmexTravel.com |
| **Prepaid Hotels** | 5X points on prepaid hotels booked through American Express Travel® | 5X points on prepaid hotel stays booked through AmexTravel.com or the AmexTravel App™ |
| **Car Rentals & Cruises** | 1X points | 2X points on prepaid car rentals and cruises booked through AmexTravel.com |
| **All Other Purchases** | 1X points | 1X points |

---

### Key Benefits & Credits Comparison

| Benefit / Credit | The Platinum Card® | American Express® Gold Card |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Airport Lounge Access** | Yes (American Express Global Lounge Collection®, Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass™ Select) | No |
| **Airline Fee Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Hotel Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Fine Hotels + Resorts®** | Yes | No |
| **The Hotel Collection** | Yes | Yes |
| **Complimentary Hotel Status** | Hilton Honors Gold & Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite | No |
| **CLEAR®+ Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Digital Entertainment Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Walmart+ Membership Credit** | Yes | No |
| **lululemon Credit** | Yes | No |
| **Uber Cash** | Yes (Uber Cash on Platinum) | Yes (Uber Cash on Gold) |
| **Resy Credit** | Yes (Resy Credit on Platinum) | Yes (Resy Credit on Gold) |
| **Dining Credit** | No | Yes |
| **Dunkin' Credit** | No | Yes |
| **Car Rental Elite Status** | Yes | Hertz Five Star Status |
| **Amex Special Ticket Access** | Yes | Yes |
| **Pay Over Time / Plan It®** | Yes | Yes |
